policy: Quality first. Keep the winning preset opt-in. Replay only during the overnight run. No photo-only fallback work.

experiments.change: Re-render published artifacts with existing camera behavior. Record original dimensions and source photos.
experiments.stopCondition: Same evidence reviewed at both viewport sizes.

experiments.change: Correct local-to-world centering, keep the same SPZ and original fit.
experiments.stopCondition: Off-center synthetic fixture and same-SPZ comparison demonstrate the correction.

experiments.change: Evaluate robust bounds then subject-region camera framing. Implement and verify subject-centered orbit and reset.
experiments.stopCondition: Stable full-chair fit where the existing asset supports it, with screenshots and tested interaction.

experiments.change: Use a no-op SPZ round trip control and a conservative large-splat removal on a copy. Hold framing and yaw constant.
experiments.stopCondition: Gain is visible across angles and thin chair geometry is retained. Otherwise record it as diagnosis.

experiments.change: If the artifact has separable background splats, test an object region or a verified floater filter on an isolated copy.
requires: reproducible target region or verified filter
experiments.stopCondition: Keep only if verified against source stills and compared by an independent reviewer.

experiments.change: Reproduce original training on Golden. Preserve selected aligned frames and poses inside the benchmark run.
experiments.stopCondition: Baseline export and report establish actual dimensions and reusable alignment.

experiments.change: Train a foreground-mask candidate after alignment with verified mask semantics. Keep input cameras and step count fixed.
experiments.stopCondition: Fewer intrusive room artifacts with no loss of legs, arms, back, or mesh. Skip if masks are unreliable.

experiments.change: Try 6000 steps on an unchanged aligned dataset with a matched 3000-step baseline. Try 9000 only if 6000 visibly improves the chair and time remains.
requires: room in time and memory budget
experiments.stopCondition: Visible gain across multiple views. Count and registration are diagnostics.

experiments.change: If quality is limited by coverage, test one sampling or orientation-aware frame-resolution change, with fresh COLMAP calibration.
experiments.stopCondition: Maintain useful angular coverage and verify dimensions and quality visually.

experiments.change: Freeze best candidate and reproduce on Repeat. Check the stress take independently and grade the remaining evidence where supported.
experiments.stopCondition: Golden and Repeat both meet ACCEPTANCE.md, with explicit stress-case verdict.

experiments.change: Compare lower real long-edge size or a lower training budget one at a time, only after a quality winner.
experiments.stopCondition: Measured time savings and no loss at the accepted visual floor.

experiments.change: Integrate verified opt-in candidate and run existing regressions and local replay if time and original footage permit.
experiments.stopCondition: Exact launch command, expected preview, named tests, and morning report are verified.
